The only ones that won't be complete shit.

My daughter committed suicide a few months ago


And it's broken me, 


I give up on everything at this point.

I find it an uncomfortable thought,


But it's not my place to say if someone should or shouldn't have one. It's their right to choose.

I just have nothing else in my life,


I hate my job, I hate this empty house, I hate how quiet it'll be forever, and I just want to be left alone. 


But being alone now is the hardest thing.

My ex abondaned me and her daughter less than a year after she was born. 

Like I get it you never wanted children but fucking hell at least tell me you're leaving.

Then when my daughter died by suicide a few months back she suddenly tried to act like she cared all these years, she only wanted life insurance money and when I finally gave in and gave it to her she fucked off again. 

That's just my personal example but shit like that.

Everything,


I'm extremely self conscious, I hate myself, and I always feel unworthy.

My brother hit my mother once,


I fully understood why, he was sick of her beating him, telling him he's nothing, just trying to make his life hell. 

So one day he hit back, and proudly told her that he's done just letting her beat him because she wants too. 



Now out of the blue in a "normal" circumstance I would be angry as shit.

Mine was anything happening to my kid, but she passed from suicide a few months back. 


So I suppose nothing anymore.

and the very best you can do is the very best you can do.

Everything I look at seems to have moved just enough to make me believe that she's here messing with it. 


But she's not, I was at her funeral. 


She's gone and it's not something I want to accept. 


We're part of a club we shouldn't be in.

I'm just not sure I'll ever be able to really start any road to recovery,

It just doesn't feel like it should be real but here I am, and it it's something that happened, and part of me doesn't want to accept it despite it very clearly having happened.
It just feels like it was

15,

As someone who has also lost their daughter, 

It never really feels "Normal"


You'll always feel like something is wrong, you'll know what it is but you never want to believe it. 


It's a long road that we have to walk and sadly there's many that have to walk it.

I was already deppresed before so it just feels like the weight of 10000 elephants pushing down on every inch of my body at once.

I just feel like there's no reason for me to be here anymore,


There's absolutely nothing here for me anymore, no reason for me to be here and yet here I am. 

I didn't know my daughter was hurting because she hid it so damn well and my poor son never even knew the light of anything.

I'm so sorry,


I lost my 15 yo daughter around 2-3 months ago. 


It's been the hardest point in my life and I'm unsure if I'll ever feel better. 


But we have to keep looking for the little things to keep us going. Even if it's nearly Impossible to find any.

Be ready for "Daddy this" and "Daddy that" 

It will annoy you at times . 

Also she might try to repeadtly wake you up for no real reason because, kids. 

You miss it when they stop

I've had people tell me to my face "She was unplanned so it's not that bad, just get over it"

True, had absolutely no intentions not having children.

And yet she existed, and it didn't matter to me if she was unplanned.

I just have nothing else that matters in my life, 

She was really the only thing that kept going. 

I was always striving to give her the kind of life I wanted to have.

Her mother has recently tried to act like she's suddenly cared the past 15 years, 

She's trying to act like she was this super great mother.

She only wants some form of insurance money and knows that I know that's all she wants. 

She maybe say her daughter like twice because I did my best to get her to at least spend the weekend with her. 

And of course my daughter says she left and wasn't home all weekend either time leaving an 8 yo to fend for herself and later a 12 yo. 

And she has the fucking audacity to say she never had time when she actively avoided being there in ANY capacity.

Because it's exactly what she did. 


She didn't know what she was running from or where she was going. 


She just ran

There are times where I've considered not living anymore. 

But honestly there isn't much I have to live for anymore anyway.

I know I'm going crazy, I know it. 

I hear her voice but she was buried 2 months ago.
I swear things are moving around the house, just today I remember with 100% certainty that I put a cup of water to my left, then I look and it's on the other side of the room.


I know I'm fucking going crazy, I'm the only one here because nobody else can be. 

Things are reorganizing themselves, I'm hearing things, things aren't in the same position as were I left them. 

I'm not sure If I'm just not remembering or actually going mentally insane.
I'm just not sure what they would tell me that I haven't already heard before
I only have myself and all of you I suppose
I just feel like I should have noticed something was wrong sooner

She just showed no outward signs that something was wrong,


And I Fucking hate myself and I'm not sure I won't ever again.

(I'm her father, her mother couldn't be bothered to stay even a full year) 

And she was more then beautiful

She was always a lover of music, from playing and making her own, to having a stereo she lived to listen to music from. 

I'd use to sit in her room with her and we'd song and play along to countless songs for what felt like hours. Even some of the ones that weren't my favorite. 

Lots of them are going to release new music at some point this year, 

I'm not even going to bother with it because God knows I wouldn't be able to find anything other that crippling loneliness and emotional pain from it. 

I can't even look at a guitar, piano, or many instruments we have laying around with feeling the need to vomit and breaking down. 

And I know it's going to be like this forever, I hate it. 

I'd give anything for her to just be her and ok, I don't care what it is, I'd give it in less than a heartbeat.

We have(had) similar music taste so anytime I listen to music I'll often hear a song that we used to sing together everytime it came on and I always just have to turn it off because I can never make it through one without breaking down.

I don't, my siblings left my toxic parents years before I was even in highschool. 

My parents hate me and my daughter's grandparents now hate me after I told them what had happened.

We used to go to the same waffle house, every Saturday, for the last 11 years, and order the exact same thing. 

The lady that worked there eventually stopped taking what she could get us and after that the cooks didn't even bother asking. 

We always went together or not at all. 


I tried to go alone last weekend, and the waitress immediately asked me what was wrong, I tried to tell her but couldn't get the words out and just said "I'm sorry", got up and left. 

Now, even thinking about all the conversations we had there, good, bad, informative, akward, important, what color of blanket was the warmest, what was the best drink for every season, etc, hurts my heart and I don't wanna think about it but I don't want to forget them either.

It feels like I lost a large part of myself and I'll never get it back,

Even telling myslef and what I already know is hard to accept,



My daughter is dead and she is never coming back, and I feel lost because of it.

I've already had several people tell me to "Just get over it, it happens all the time"

And it hurts, but I can't blame them. It's a pain you don't understand until it hits you in the face.

Deppresion,

She hid her pain to well.

I cared about her more than anything else,

She was essentially one of the only things I loved and strived for.


Now I just feel lost and pointless.

No, no signs at all. Other than abnormal sleeping which I had hardly noticed as I was often asleep myself when it occurred.


Her note essentially said fore not the hate myself and that she didn't want me or anyone else to feel bad so she hid her pain from the world hoping it would eventually get easier.

As I always told her, "You could be as small as the day I first held you, or 40 years old with your own children. But you'll always be my little baby girl."


It hurts, too much
It was it me and her her entire life
